name: Nadia Haddad
headline: Backend Developer
summary: Backend engineer focused on building reliable service layers and integrating business systems through clean APIs. Experienced in distributed services, test-driven delivery, and operational improvements across product teams. Comfortable working across implementation, troubleshooting, and release coordination in fast-moving environments.

roles.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Built backend services in Microservices and REST APIs, packaging them with Docker and coordinating rollout across shared infrastructure.
Implemented message-driven workflows with RabbitMQ and OAuth to support secure account flows, reducing manual handoffs by 30%.
Created automated checks with JUnit and Kubernetes, improving release confidence for 4 service teams.
Refined service interfaces and operational behavior through Docker and REST APIs, helping cut incident follow-up time by 25%.

roles.title: API Engineer
bullets: Delivered new service features in Scala and Microservices under Agile planning, keeping delivery aligned with product priorities.
Optimized data access with Hibernate and Redis, lowering common request latency by 40%.
Strengthened platform reliability by updating Docker, Kubernetes and JUnit-based verification across the backend.
Worked with cross-functional peers to shape deployment changes and service contracts, supporting 2 major releases.
